entries.title: French Horn Tide Pool
entries.artBrief: french horn with one enormous curled shell shape; one simple toy-like icon.
entries.originalArtBrief: An enormous open french horn contains a miniature tide pool: one huge shell arch over a broad pool. One large enclosing silhouette and one clear inner landscape, no tiny clutter.

entries.title: Shooting Star Seed Harvest
entries.artBrief: shooting star with one oversized seed scoop attached to the main silhouette; one simple toy-like icon.
entries.originalArtBrief: A huge shooting star holds a magical seed harvest: one enormous leaf scoop harvests glowing seeds. Broad celestial silhouette, one large garden mechanism, no tiny stars or writing.
